failure_location: The inherited single-pair image loader required exactly six cohort images; the frozen three-view memory cohort contains ten images.
decision_impact: No frozen image was opened and no model was loaded or called. The successor loader removes only the exact-six assertion while preserving every image receipt, pair, model, carrier calculation, threshold and gate.
claim_boundary: This receipt proves only a mechanical pre-model abort. It is not a model result and does not count as a pass or failure of the frozen memory decision gate.
